status.summary: Veteran top-10 UFC bantamweight on a two-fight skid. He lost a title challenge to Merab Dvalishvili at UFC 320 (Oct 4, 2025, UD 49-45, 49-45, 49-46). He then lost a 29-28 x3 decision to Mario Bautista at UFC 329 (Jul 11, 2026), where a Suloev stretch into a kneebar at the end of round 1 left him fearing a torn hamstring. In mid-July he said he was getting an MRI. No result, return date or booking was found.
status.ranking: #6 bantamweight on ufcalendar.com's main list (updated Nov 3, 2026); a Wikipedia snippet also listed him #6 as of Aug 29, 2026

injuries.what: Feared torn hamstring from Bautista's Suloev stretch/kneebar late in round 1 at UFC 329. He fought the last two rounds hampered and posted photos of heavy bruising behind the leg. Diagnosis not found.

style.summary: A tall, rangy switch-stance striker (5'11" at 135) who controls range with footwork, long punches and inside low kicks, and can end fights suddenly with wheel kicks and flying knees. His losses since 2021 have come against elite wrestlers and grapplers who drag him into long control phases. He has never been stopped by strikes in the UFC.

moves.notes: Weights are relative within each target group, as src/director.js uses them: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1. spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. fighters.json time-decayed attempt split is 80.3% head, 9.7% body and 10.0% leg (landed 65.8/14.6/19.6). Head share is slightly above the bantamweight average of 76.2%, body share is below 14.1%, and leg share is average. The head group leans on long straight punches (jab 0.28, cross 0.25) to fit a rangy switch-stance striker known for footwork (Sportskeeda), with headkick 0.10 because kicks to the head are a known finishing weapon (Moraes KO). In the leg group, inside leads: UFC 329 coverage describes him 'firing inside low kicks while circling'. The body split is a default kicker split and is not specifically sourced. spinning 0.08 and knee 0.08 reflect two documented highlight finishes, the Moraes wheel kick and the Edgar flying knee (ufcstats). They are rare events, so keep them low.

engine_notes.note: Opponents took him down 4.9 times per 15 min time-decayed (26.3 of 58.3 attempts), up from 2.9 career, and held 11.6 s/min of control. Against a strong wrestler his grappling defence is the main path to a loss.
Leg strikes are near-automatic: 90% accuracy career, including 10/10 vs Bautista, 16/18 vs Dvalishvili and 19/20 vs Figueiredo.
He throws 10.85 sig strikes per minute career vs an 8.70 bantamweight average. That fell to 9.36 time-decayed as recent opponents grappled him.
He has been knocked down twice in 17 UFC fights (Petr Yan 2021, Bautista 2026) and never stopped by strikes. His only stoppage loss was a submission.
